title: Dark prompt card types, zooms in, cursor presses send
summary: A small dark prompt card types a two-line request at speed, the camera springs in toward its left half, then a pointer slides up and presses the blue send button. A 4.5 s silent loop of one prompt being written and sent.
use_when: Showing that an AI tool starts from one typed request
A short insert before a result or answer scene
Silent autoplay social clip for a prompt-driven product
Opening beat of a longer ai-chat film

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, 2 lines, ~2.5 % H before the zoom, ~6 % H after

sfx.event: camera springs in on the card

structure.shot: empty dark rounded prompt card, ~45 % W, centred; plus icon bottom-left, blue send arrow bottom-right; first line types
structure.camera: drift: zoom -1.1 %/s, pan ~21 px/s down (1920 frame), near static
structure.motion: typing starts ~f2 at ~50 chars/s, easings.linear, no caret visible (±0.25 s); card widens ~10 % as the first line fills, springs.layout (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: request wraps to a second line and finishes with a period; card grows one line taller
structure.camera: drift: zoom -0.6 %/s, pan ~11 px/s, near static
structure.motion: typing continues ~50 chars/s, done at ~1.77 s (f53, ±0.25 s); card height grows one line, springs.layout (overshoot not measurable); 7 fr hold before the zoom

structure.shot: camera pushes into the card's text, left edge of the text leaves frame; card fills the upper left
structure.camera: zoom-tier region→element: scale 1.00→~1.6 (±10 %), toward upper left, pan ~245 px/s left and ~160 px/s up
structure.motion: springs.cameraIn, f60→~f87 settle (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); then static hold to f98

structure.shot: white pointer hand enters from below right, lands on the send button and presses it; holds to the end
structure.motion: cursor-path from below-right, lands on the button by f105 (±0.25 s), springs.ui; press squash springs.click ~f105–f113 (±0.25 s); hold 37 fr

params.content.prompt: one request, ~80 characters, wraps to 2 lines at the card width
params.accent: send button colour, defaults to brand accent

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Typing ~50 chars/s, done ~1.77 s; zoom 2.00→~2.90 s at ~1.6x toward upper left; cursor first visible 3.27 s, on the button by 3.50 s. No cuts, silent. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term: multiline-prompt-card (card that grows with wrapped text).
